tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background (light: very light warm gray, neutral-0; dark: dark gray).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, dialogs. Sits on bg with shadow-card.

tokens.name: surface-sub
tokens.usage: Zebra rows, segmented controls, gray buttons, skeletons, code blocks in light.

tokens.name: surface-chrome
tokens.usage: Top bar, sidebar and bottom tab bar. In dark a step lighter than bg so the frame separates from the page.

tokens.name: surface-input
tokens.usage: Text field background.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text. 4.5:1 or more on bg, surface, surface-sub, surface-chrome and accent-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, captions. 4.5:1 or more on bg, surface, surface-sub, surface-chrome and accent-soft.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: table rows, dividers, header and sidebar edges. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders: text fields, outline buttons, checkboxes. Meets 3:1 on surface and surface-sub.

tokens.name: graph-edge
tokens.usage: Lines, arrows and node borders in diagrams (architecture graphs). Lighter in dark so lines stay visible on surface.

tokens.name: graph-node
tokens.usage: Node fill in diagrams; selected nodes use accent-soft with an accent border.

tokens.name: code-keyword
tokens.usage: Syntax colour for keywords in CodeView. 4.5:1 on surface-sub in both themes.

tokens.name: code-constant
tokens.usage: Syntax colour for constants and numbers in CodeView. 4.5:1 on surface-sub.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one brand hue as a fill: primary buttons, switches, checkboxes, progress, the selected nav indicator. 3:1 or more on bg, surface, surface-sub, surface-chrome and accent-soft, with on-accent text 4.5:1 on it; in dark the default #2457d6 is lightened (white 5% at a time) until it does. Replaceable by the user; setAccent derives it with the same rule.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover: the accent with 12% black in light, 12% white in dark.

tokens.name: accent-press
tokens.usage: Primary button pressed: the accent with 22% black in light, 22% white in dark.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links, icons and selected labels. 4.5:1 on bg, surface, surface-sub, surface-chrome and accent-soft in both themes; setAccent derives it from a custom accent with the same rule.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Soft accent fill: selected options, rows and dates, the phone tab bar pill, highlighted code lines, drop zones, bulk-action bars, selected diagram nodes. Light: white with 12% accent; dark: surface with 22% accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills: white or ink, whichever contrasts more (4.5:1 or more).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus outline of every control: 2px solid, 2px outside (inside where a container clips). Equals accent-text, so 3:1 or more on every ground; setAccent keeps it in step.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Old name of focus, kept for pages written before it; same value. Use focus.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success fill, bar and icon. 3:1 or more on bg, surface, surface-sub, surface-chrome and the table's row hover. Status marks beside text use success-text.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Success text on success-soft, bg, surface, surface-sub, surface-chrome and accent-soft (4.5:1).

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success alert and badge fill.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning fill, bar and icon. 3:1 or more on bg, surface, surface-sub, surface-chrome and the table's row hover. Status marks beside text use warning-text.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Warning text on warning-soft, bg, surface, surface-sub, surface-chrome and accent-soft (4.5:1).

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning alert and badge fill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error borders, error icon, destructive button fill (on-danger text). 3:1 or more on bg, surface, surface-sub, surface-chrome and the table's row hover; lighter in dark for that.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons on danger fills (the danger button, count badges): white in light, ink in dark, 4.5:1 or more.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Error messages on danger-soft, bg, surface, surface-sub, surface-chrome and accent-soft (4.5:1).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error alert fill.

tokens.name: info-text
tokens.usage: Info text on info-soft, bg, surface, surface-sub, surface-chrome and accent-soft (4.5:1).

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Info alert fill.

tokens.name: on-solid
tokens.usage: Text and icons on fixed solid fills: file-type labels, color swatches.

tokens.name: danger-ring
tokens.usage: Old focus glow of a field with an error, kept for pages written before; now the value of danger-text. Fields with an error show the focus outline like every control.

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: Background of the matched text in search results.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs, drawers and the command palette (with the blur).

tokens.name: scrim-strong
tokens.usage: The page around the Tour's spotlight.

tokens.name: edge-shadow
tokens.usage: Shadow on the edge of a column that stays in place while a table scrolls sideways.

tokens.name: file-other
tokens.usage: Extension label of a file icon: any other file. White text (on-solid) on it.

tokens.name: file-pdf
tokens.usage: Extension label of a file icon: PDF. White text (on-solid) on it.

tokens.name: file-video
tokens.usage: Extension label of a file icon: video. White text (on-solid) on it.

tokens.name: file-audio
tokens.usage: Extension label of a file icon: audio. White text (on-solid) on it.

tokens.name: file-slides
tokens.usage: Extension label of a file icon: slides (PPTX, KEY). White text (on-solid) on it.

tokens.name: file-doc
tokens.usage: Extension label of a file icon: documents (DOCX, PAGES). White text (on-solid) on it.

tokens.name: file-sheet
tokens.usage: Extension label of a file icon: spreadsheets (XLSX, CSV). White text (on-solid) on it.

tokens.name: file-image
tokens.usage: Extension label of a file icon: images. White text (on-solid) on it.

tokens.name: file-code
tokens.usage: Extension label of a file icon: code and text. White text (on-solid) on it.

tokens.name: text-mini
tokens.usage: Smallest text in the system: Tag, chart axis ticks, counts, keyboard keys, file-type labels, field names of a table row on phones. Nothing goes below 12 px.

tokens.name: text-small
tokens.usage: Hints, helper text, captions, meta lines, breadcrumbs; the minimum on monitoring screens.

tokens.name: text-compact
tokens.usage: Dense UI text: menu items, table headers, field labels, alerts, toasts, dialog body, numbers in tables.

tokens.name: text-control
tokens.usage: Text inside controls: buttons, text fields, select options, tabs, navigation rows, tree rows; code blocks.

tokens.name: text-body
tokens.usage: Default paragraph and UI text.

tokens.name: text-title
tokens.usage: Card title and table caption (the same size), notification panel title.

tokens.name: text-lead
tokens.usage: Intro paragraph under h1; titles of a settings group and the danger zone.

tokens.name: text-h4
tokens.usage: Dialog, drawer and section titles; top bar title; Markdown #.

tokens.name: text-h3
tokens.usage: Title of a page that stands alone (login, error page, settings page), chart headline, Markdown ###.

tokens.name: text-h2
tokens.usage: Section title on long pages; the big number of a KPI card or a zone.

tokens.name: text-h1
tokens.usage: Page title, one per page.

tokens.name: space-4

tokens.name: space-8

tokens.name: radius-sm

tokens.name: radius-chip

tokens.name: radius-md

tokens.name: radius-lg

tokens.name: shadow-card-hover

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs, toasts, popovers.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons and text fields on desktop.

tokens.name: chip-height

tokens.name: touch-target

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Top bar.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Expanded sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-collapsed

tokens.name: tabbar-height
tokens.usage: Mobile bottom tab bar.

tokens.name: icon-stroke
tokens.usage: Stroke width of every line icon (24 px grid).

tokens.name: alert-bar

tokens.name: bp-tablet

tokens.name: bp-desktop

tokens.name: bp-wide

tokens.name: dur-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and press feedback, color changes, fades of popovers and backdrops.

tokens.name: dur-menu

tokens.name: dur-nav

tokens.name: dur-tooltip

tokens.name: dur-expand
tokens.usage: Section open and close, tree children growing out of a folder, bottom sheets.

tokens.name: dur-toggle

tokens.name: dur-drawer
tokens.usage: Drawer springing in.

tokens.name: dur-bar
tokens.usage: Each bar of a bar chart growing (40 ms apart).

tokens.name: dur-chart
tokens.usage: Each line of a line chart drawing in; KPI numbers and rings counting up.

tokens.name: dur-loop
tokens.usage: One round of the indeterminate loading droplet.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Default ease-out for things that move in or settle.

tokens.name: ease-glide
tokens.usage: Indicators and panels gliding between positions (tab indicator, split panes, workbench side panels).

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: A slight overshoot: tooltips, popovers, the drawer springing in.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Things leaving: drawers and side panels sliding out.

tokens.name: z-base
tokens.usage: Inside a component: a layer that must stay under its siblings but still form a stacking context.

tokens.name: z-raised
tokens.usage: Inside a component: one step above the content (sticky table column, resize grips, hit areas).

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Inside a component: the step over raised content (sticky table header, code view tools, graph labels). The sticky header cell of a sticky column is calc(var(--z-sticky) + 1).

tokens.name: z-float
tokens.usage: Inside a component: a tip or panel floating over its content (chart tooltip, collapsed-sidebar label, workbench panels). Workbench layers sit at calc(var(--z-float) - 1) to + 4.

tokens.name: z-header
tokens.usage: The app shell top bar.

tokens.name: z-rail
tokens.usage: The app shell side rail, above the top bar.

tokens.name: z-hint
tokens.usage: Feature hint bubble beside an icon button (IconButton hint).

tokens.name: z-drawer
tokens.usage: Drawer backdrop; the drawer itself is calc(var(--z-drawer) + 1).

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Dialog and term sheet backdrop; their panel is calc(var(--z-modal) + 1).

tokens.name: z-palette
tokens.usage: Command palette backdrop and the settings save bar; the palette is calc(var(--z-palette) + 1).

tokens.name: z-tour
tokens.usage: Tour spotlight; its card is calc(var(--z-tour) + 1).

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: Select and other lists that open from a control, above dialogs.

tokens.name: z-tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltips and the skip link: always on top.

presets.name: 教材
presets.usage: Slidev teaching slides. Hybrid: neutrals and fonts from the design system; the accent, square corners and thin borders from the slide style. Light only. Use: initTheme({ preset: "teaching" }), or data-theme-preset="teaching" on the root element before initTheme().
